title: Observe the ordinary special pose task chain
changes: Trace the upstream task and pose call entries for the previously witnessed ordinary special-pose reads.
validation: Windows GNU build special-task-chain-build-ddr8e8bg and Wine special-task-chain-wine-_uuybpg0 passed. In the frame-345 interpreter replay, ordered entries and link registers observe task 0812a8c4 calling 0809d9c4 at 0812a93c, which calls 0809ae1c at 0809d9e6, followed by the established 0809ae70 pose reader. The task supplies animation base 64. Full serialized state, central framebuffer and OAM match native continuation, zero trace events were dropped, protected inputs passed and Wine drained.
limitations: The task address and observed call chain do not prove which opcode created it, full task group or actual script selector. Native instruction attribution, complete animation, other paths and checkpoint ancestry remain unproved. Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
